name: Glorious Anthem — a counter added later gets its own later timestamp in 7c
notes: Memory: project_counter_per_counter_timestamp_2026-06-18 and project_layer7_merge_counters_into_modify_2026-06-18. Counters and boosts share sublayer 7c; the counter must be stamped when it was placed (after the Anthem), not with the permanent's own earlier timestamp, and must survive restore. Bears 2/2 + Anthem +1/+1 + counter +1/+1 = 4/4, and the counter must not create a false dependency with the Anthem.
